skills.name: Localized Liquidation
skills.description: Next attack causes 2 additional aftershocks and <$ba.stun>Stuns</> all targets for <@ba.vup>{stun_duration}</>s. This attack has a <@ba.vup>slightly increased</> splash area, and aftershock damage becomes <@ba.vup>{append_atk_scale:0%}</> ATK.

skills.name: Explosive Dawn
skills.description:
Immediately summons <@ba.vup>{max_cnt}</> Revenant's Shadow(s) in attack range (up to 3 at a time, they remain after skill expires). ATK <@ba.vup>+{atk:0%}</>. Attack Interval is <@ba.vdown>greatly increased</>. Attacks deal <@ba.vup>{attack@atk_scale_3:0%}</> ATK. Splash area is <@ba.vup>greatly increased</>. Talent 1 trigger chance is increased to <@ba.vup>{attack@prob:0%}</>.
<@ba.rem>Skill activation grants {attack@trigger_time} ammo and the skill ends when all ammo is used (Can manually deactivate skill)</>

stages.name: Conspirator α
stages.description: When this Operator is assigned to the Control Center: if <@cc.kw>Ines</> is assigned to the Reception Room, clue collection speed <@cc.vup>+5%</>; if <@cc.kw>Hoederer</> is assigned to a Trading Post, that Trading Post's order limit <@cc.vup>+1</>.

stages.name: Conspirator β
stages.description: When this Operator is assigned to the Control Center: if <@cc.kw>Ines</> is assigned to the Reception Room, clue collection speed <@cc.vup>+5%</>; if <@cc.kw>Hoederer</> is assigned to a Trading Post, that Trading Post's order limit <@cc.vup>+2</>.

stages.name: Banner of Babel
stages.description: When this Operator is assigned to the Control Center, Operators working in <$cc.c.room2><@cc.kw>other buildings</></> recover <@cc.vup>+0.1</> Morale per hour, with an additional <@cc.vup>+0.1</> when <@cc.kw>Civilight Eterna</> is also assigned to the Control Center (<$cc.c.sui2_1><@cc.rem>Special Comparison Rules</></> apply with Control Center bonus).

stages.name: Souvenir
stages.description: Attacks attach an afterimage to the main target. Afterimages have a 15% chance to explode when affected by Wiš'adel's aftershock, dealing 120% ATK as Physical damage to all nearby enemies and <$ba.stun>Stunning</> them for 0.5s.

stages.name: Souvenir
stages.description: Attacks attach an afterimage to the main target. Afterimages have a 15% chance to explode when affected by Wiš'adel's aftershock, dealing 130% <@ba.talpu>(+10%)</> ATK as Physical damage to all nearby enemies and <$ba.stun>Stunning</> them for 0.5s.

stages.name: Souvenir
stages.description: Attacks have 115% ATK against the main target and attach an afterimage to it. Afterimages have a 15% chance to explode when affected by Wiš'adel's aftershock, dealing 150% ATK as Physical damage to all nearby enemies and <$ba.stun>Stunning</> them for 1s.

stages.name: Revenant's Echo
stages.description: After deployment, immediately summons a Revenant's Shadow in attack range, and gains <$ba.camou>Camouflage</> when near a Revenant's Shadow.
